override_dmlab_defaults: override the default encoder and observation scaling parameters for DeepMind Lab environments using dmlab_override_defaults
add_dmlab_env_args: add command-line arguments for DeepMind Lab environment configuration including resolution, renderer, and GPU settings
configure_dmlab_resolution: configure the DeepMind Lab game frame width and height using the res_w and res_h arguments
enable_dmlab_hardware_rendering: enable GPU hardware rendering for DeepMind Lab by setting dmlab_renderer to hardware and specifying GPU indices
configure_dmlab_level_caching: configure the DeepMind Lab level cache path and enable or disable local level caching for faster environment loading
